root_cause_label: Agent falsely assumed it had no access to leaderboard data and guessed an English embedding model for a Scandinavian task
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent immediately decided it could not access the MTEB leaderboard and wrote a guessed English-focused model (BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5) rather than programmatically retrieving the correct Scandinavian top model (GritLM/GritLM-7B).
t_err_evidence: In step 1, the agent explicitly states 'Since I don't have direct access to browse the internet or check real-time data... I'll need to make an educated guess' — a false premise, as the agent could have used git clone or the mteb Python library to retrieve the leaderboard data.
t_commit_evidence: In step 2, the agent writes 'BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5' to /app/result.txt, committing the wrong (guessed, English-focused) answer as the final output.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the unverified assumption that it lacked the ability to access the MTEB leaderboard data. In fact, tools such as git clone or the mteb Python package were available in the environment and could have been used to retrieve the actual leaderboard rankings. This false premise led directly to the decision to guess.
